AHI ST-TROPEZ, Explore Hardware Knurled St. Tropez in Satin Brass

This beautiful modern round deadbolt is the perfect addition to any door. Made of solid brass and finished in satin brass gold you can feel secure while keeping the style that your home desires. Our deadbolt is made to work in any climate outdoors or look beautiful on the inside of any home, office or any door that needs keyed locking.

Our deadbolts are designed to work on almost any door with an adjustable door thickness from 1 3/8'' to 1 3/4'' and an adjustable backset of 2 3/8'' and 2 3/4''.

Features of the Satin Brass Modern Round Deadbolt:

  • Fits standard door cut outs (2-1/8" pre-drilled doors).
  • Sold as complete set.
  • Easy to install.

Specifications of the Satin Brass Modern Round Deadbolt:

  • Finish: Satin Brass
  • Deadbolt Diameter: 2-3/8" (60mm)
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/8" to 1-3/4"
  • Backset: 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"

Functions:

  • Single Cylinder: The deadbolt is thrown and retracted by a key from both the exterior and the interior.

Sold Individually
